raster.explanation: Run the raster preparation recipe: crop, integer magnification, quarter turns, explicit alpha and optional indexed sheet.
pitfalls: Encoded sRGB sample arithmetic; no colour management, smoothing, scripts or visual text labels.
Only bounded RGB/RGBA8 PNG with exact independent pixel qualification.

fields.explanation: Prepare exact PNG details for comparison or publication. Inputs become captured immutable evidence; native ImageMagick executes only this bounded recipe.
pitfalls: Choose a supported PNG rather than authoring a command or format prefix.

/properties/version.explanation: Select the PNG preparation document contract. This identifies authored structure, not the installed ImageMagick release.
pitfalls: Use schemaxis.imagemagick/1.

/properties/operation.explanation: Run the raster preparation recipe: crop, integer magnification, quarter turns, explicit alpha and optional indexed sheet.
pitfalls: Other ImageMagick operations are outside this contract.

/properties/images.explanation: List 1–8 images in output order. Each becomes image-NN.png and one sheet tile if a sheet is enabled. Combined input and output budgets apply.
pitfalls: Order determines artifact index and row-major tile placement.

/properties/images/items.explanation: Describe one captured PNG and its exact pixel preparation. ID labels its metadata; filenames are generated from order.
pitfalls: Omit crop for the whole source; scale 1 and quarterTurns 0 preserve dimensions.

/properties/images/items/properties/id.explanation: Give this view a distinct ASCII metadata identifier, beginning with a letter and using letters, numbers, hyphen or underscore.
pitfalls: IDs are metadata, not visual labels; repeated IDs are rejected.

/properties/images/items/properties/sour.explanation: Choose an absolute existing local RGB/RGBA8 non-interlaced PNG. Its bytes are captured and independently decoded before the native child; verified image artifact bindings also resolve here.
pitfalls: No URLs, prefixes, symlinks, palette/greyscale/16-bit, APNG or ICC profiles. Changing bytes at the same path invalidates reuse.

/properties/images/items/properties/crop.explanation: Select a rectangular detail measured from the top-left of the source in integer pixels. Omitting crop retains every source sample.
pitfalls: The rectangle must lie completely inside the source; it never clips or pads automatically.

/properties/images/items/properties/crop.explanation: Zero-based left edge in source pixels, increasing rightward. x=1 starts at the second source column.
pitfalls: x plus width must not exceed source width.

/properties/images/items/properties/crop.explanation: Zero-based top edge in source pixels, increasing downward. y=1 starts at the second source row.
pitfalls: y plus height must not exceed source height.

/properties/images/items/properties/crop.explanation: Number of source columns retained. Width 2 includes exactly two columns beginning at x.
pitfalls: Use a positive integer; this is not the right-edge coordinate.

/properties/images/items/properties/crop.explanation: Number of source rows retained. Height 2 includes exactly two rows beginning at y.
pitfalls: Use a positive integer; this is not the bottom-edge coordinate.

/properties/images/items/properties/scal.explanation: Magnify each cropped source pixel into an equal square of this integer side length. Default 1 retains sampling; 2 doubles each side.
pitfalls: Only 1–8 nearest-neighbour magnification is supported; no smoothing or downsampling.

/properties/images/items/properties/quar.explanation: Rotate clockwise in quarter turns after cropping and magnification: 0 unchanged, 1 right, 2 upside-down, 3 left. Default 0.
pitfalls: Odd values exchange width and height; arbitrary angles are unsupported.

/properties/colourPolicy.explanation: require-srgb, the default, requires an sRGB chunk or standard matching gAMA+cHRM. assume-srgb also admits untagged encoded samples and records that explicit assumption.
pitfalls: No colour conversion or profile inference occurs. Output PNGs are untagged; chain them with assume-srgb only when their interpretation is established.

/properties/alpha.explanation: preserve, the default, retains every RGBA sample including hidden RGB at zero alpha. flatten replaces alpha with 255 using the chosen RGB background.
pitfalls: Flatten blends encoded sRGB channels by nearest-integer arithmetic, not linear-light compositing; alpha is discarded.

/properties/background.explanation: Choose the RGB background for flatten as three encoded sRGB byte channels [red,green,blue]. Default [255,255,255] is white.
pitfalls: Omit it when preserving alpha; non-default unused backgrounds are rejected. It is separate from the sheet background.

/properties/background/items.explanation: One encoded sRGB byte channel, 0–255. The enclosing order is red, green, blue; 0 is minimum and 255 maximum.
pitfalls: No unit conversion, normalized 0–1 values or colour names are accepted.

/properties/sheet.explanation: Optionally publish a row-major contact sheet and JSON index. Tiles occupy equal cells based on the largest prepared dimensions. Omitting sheet publishes individual images only.
pitfalls: Tile RGBA samples copy exactly, including transparent samples; no font labels or automatic fitting are added.

/properties/sheet/properties/columns.explanation: Number of equal cells per row, default 2. Images fill left to right, then top to bottom; remaining cells stay background.
pitfalls: Cannot exceed image count; choose 1 explicitly for a one-image sheet.

/properties/sheet/properties/padding.explanation: Pixels of opaque background around the sheet and between cells, default 8. Zero places cells immediately adjacent.
pitfalls: Padding increases the aggregate output pixel budget and never rescales tiles.

/properties/sheet/properties/background.explanation: Three encoded sRGB RGB bytes for the opaque sheet canvas, default white. Gaps and unused portions of cells keep this colour.
pitfalls: Transparent tile pixels replace the canvas with their own complete RGBA values; use alpha flatten for opaque tiles.

/properties/sheet/properties/background/.explanation: One encoded sRGB background byte, 0–255, in red/green/blue order. Canvas alpha is always 255.
pitfalls: These are encoded byte values, not normalized intensities or linear-light samples.
